optimizedContext.value:
# GetGuideOutlineQuery

Topic → `GuideOutline` structural map: doc stats + heading/line-span sections, no body text. Cheap token probe for agents & tools.

## Rules

- Impl `GetGuideOutlineQuery` (application layer). Input `{ topic: string }`.
- Ctor takes `GuideCatalogPort`, wraps `GetGuideQuery`. Unknown topic → `GuideTopicNotFoundError` (`error.code` `'UNKNOWN_GUIDE_TOPIC'`) thrown by inner `GetGuideQuery`, propagated uncaught (not re-thrown locally).
- Returns `GuideOutline`:
  - `topic` — canonical topic id; `GetGuideQuery` normalizes: trim, strip trailing `.md`, lowercase.
  - `file` — **SYNTHESIZED bare filename** = `` `${guide.topic}.md` ``. NOT a real path: no dir component, no collection info. Coincides with real file only while topic == lowercased basename of a single-dir catalog. Breaks for namespaced `collection:topic` keys: `core:ports` → `core:ports.md`, no such file.
  - `lines` ← `guide.lineCount`; `bytes` ← `guide.byteLength` (UTF-8 bytes of body, frontmatter excluded).
  - `sections` ← `guide.outline` verbatim (`GuideSection[]`): `index` 1-indexed, `heading` (no leading `#`), `level` 1–6, `startLine`/`endLine` 1-indexed, `lines` = `endLine - startLine + 1`. Also carries `startOffset`/`endOffset` (0-indexed char offsets) by pass-through — unlisted in spec text but present in generated catalog. `content` stays `undefined`; sliced on demand by `GetGuideSectionQuery`.
- Document with zero `#` headings → `sections: []`; `lines` still reports total doc lines.
- Single heading case: heading at line N, next equal-level heading at N+1 → `startLine === endLine === N`, `lines === 1`.

## Constraints

- Pure application query. Deps: `GuideCatalogPort` + domain models/errors only. No fs, no I/O.
- All section boundaries 1-indexed; `endLine` inclusive.
- MUST NOT emit full body content (token cost).
- `file` is a display label, NOT a resolvable path — consumers MUST NOT open it as one.

Deps: `guide:conventions`, `guide:guide-model` (owns `GuideOutline` field declarations).
